connectors.name: context7
connectors.description: Up-to-date library documentation and code examples through MCP.

connectors.name: deepwiki
connectors.description: Ask questions about public GitHub repositories through DeepWiki MCP.

connectors.name: github
connectors.description: Official GitHub MCP server for repositories, code, issues, pull requests and Actions. Requires Docker; authenticates with GitHub OAuth on first use.

connectors.name: playwright
connectors.description: Official Microsoft browser automation MCP using structured accessibility snapshots for reliable web navigation and testing.

connectors.name: chrome-devtools
connectors.description: Official Chrome DevTools MCP for debugging pages, inspecting console/network activity and analyzing browser performance.

connectors.name: microsoft-learn
connectors.description: Official, no-auth MCP access to current Microsoft Learn documentation and code samples for .NET, Azure and Microsoft technologies.

connectors.name: markitdown
connectors.description: Microsoft MCP server for converting PDFs, Office documents, HTML, images and other supported resources to Markdown for LLM use.

connectors.name: blender
connectors.description: Community MCP for AI-assisted Blender scene creation, inspection, materials, rendering and asset workflows. Requires the Blender addon.

connectors.name: memory
connectors.description: Local knowledge-graph memory server from the MCP reference servers.

connectors.name: fetch
connectors.description: Reference MCP server for retrieving and converting web content.

connectors.name: sequential-thinking
connectors.description: Reference MCP server for structured multi-step problem solving with revision and branching during complex analysis.

connectors.name: openclaw
connectors.description: Connect to a local OpenClaw MCP gateway using its CLI stdio transport.

connectors.name: filesystem
connectors.description: Official MCP reference server for local file and directory operations. By default exposes the process working directory; edit the allowed path argument before enabling when needed.

connectors.name: time
connectors.description: Official MCP reference server for current time, timezone lookup and timezone conversion.

connectors.name: mcp-docs
connectors.description: Official remote MCP server for current Model Context Protocol documentation and specification guidance.

connectors.name: docker-mcp-gateway
connectors.description: Official Docker MCP Gateway over stdio for routing a configured Docker MCP Toolkit catalog/profile through one MCP connection.

connectors.name: redis
connectors.description: Official Redis MCP server for inspecting, querying and managing Redis data. Defaults to a local Redis instance on 127.0.0.1:6379 database 0.

connectors.name: mongodb
connectors.description: Official MongoDB MCP server for MongoDB databases and Atlas. Set MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING in the environment or connect through the server tools.

connectors.name: elasticsearch
connectors.description: Official Elasticsearch MCP server via Docker. Set ES_URL and ES_API_KEY in the PyGPT environment before enabling.

connectors.name: brave-search
connectors.description: Official Brave Search MCP server for web, image, video and rich search results. Requires BRAVE_API_KEY.

connectors.name: supabase
connectors.description: Official hosted Supabase MCP server for projects, databases, SQL, logs and generated types. Supports SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN for non-interactive authentication.

connectors.name: supabase-local
connectors.description: Official MCP endpoint exposed by a local Supabase CLI development stack.

connectors.name: neon
connectors.description: Official hosted Neon MCP server for projects, branches, schema, querying and database diagnostics. Set NEON_API_KEY for direct bearer-token authentication.

connectors.name: linear
connectors.description: Official Linear remote MCP server for issues, projects and comments. Set LINEAR_API_KEY for direct bearer-token authentication.

connectors.name: sentry
connectors.description: Official Sentry remote MCP server for errors, issues, traces and project diagnostics. Set SENTRY_ACCESS_TOKEN; the server accepts it using the Sentry-Bearer authorization scheme.

connectors.name: cloudflare-docs
connectors.description: Official Cloudflare documentation MCP server for current Workers and Cloudflare platform reference information.

connectors.name: qdrant
connectors.description: Official Qdrant MCP server for semantic memory/vector search. Defaults to local Qdrant on 127.0.0.1:6333 and collection 'pygpt'; edit environment values for Qdrant Cloud.

connectors.name: grafana
connectors.description: Official Grafana MCP server for dashboards, metrics, alerts, logs and observability workflows. Configure GRAFANA_URL and GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN before enabling.

connectors.name: kubernetes
connectors.description: Popular native Kubernetes/OpenShift MCP server with kubeconfig auto-detection, resource management, pod diagnostics and multi-cluster support.

connectors.name: atlassian
connectors.description: Official Atlassian MCP v2 for Jira, Confluence and related Atlassian apps. Set ATLASSIAN_MCP_API_KEY to a service-account API key when API-token authentication is enabled by your organization.

connectors.name: baizhi-agent-toolkit
connectors.description: Hosted web search, page reading and structured extraction. Requires a Baizhi Cloud account and BAIZHI_API_KEY; calls send inputs to Baizhi Cloud and may use paid credits. The linked MIT client integration excludes the hosted backend.
